visualize_tracks_on_images: visualize object tracks on video frames and save individual frames plus a grid image to an output directory
get_track_colors_by_position: compute RGB color values for each track based on its first visible position using a matplotlib colormap
color_from_xy: map an (x, y) coordinate to an RGB color using a normalized colormap like hsv or rainbow
review_visual_track: review the visual_track module functions for track visualization, color mapping, and grid image generation
summarize_visual_track: summarize the visual_track module which provides utilities for coloring and visualizing object tracks on image frames
